name: Per-ray register accumulation for volume rendering
definition: A forward pass optimization where RGB, depth, and opacity are accumulated in per-thread registers (stack-allocated) rather than global memory, writing each per-ray output exactly once to eliminate per-sample global-memory read-modify-write operations.
summary: Per-ray register accumulation optimizes direct volume ray casting by accumulating values in per-thread registers and writing to global memory only once, significantly reducing memory traffic.
